name: h3.density_grid
description: Feature density grid across H3 cells intersecting a bbox (from materialized view)
querySql: SELECT h3_index::text, feature_count, ST_AsGeoJSON(hull_geom)::jsonb AS hull, last_updated FROM tessera.mv_h3_density_r7 WHERE hull_geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(:minLon, :minLat, :maxLon, :maxLat, 4326) ORDER BY feature_count DESC LIMIT :limit
